messages:
Alex W: quick signal — ran a few p99 latency firehose runs. host-side parse + grpc write path is ~7-12ms for short (<64 token) responses, outside kernel decode time. suspecting socket fragmentation + small writev calls.
Maya S: ugh that's regress relative to last week? numbers?
Alex W: baseline (master @ 2026-03-15): median extra host overhead 8.9ms, p95 11.8ms. trace attached (snippet):
```text
socket_writev: 4.2ms
parse_frame: 2.1ms
kv_cache_lookup: 1.3ms
json_serial: 0.9ms
```
Jason R: can you paste the perf sample? is it syscall or userspace copy?
Alex W: mostly syscall overhead on writev + epoll_ctl churn. Also seeing a lot of small packets (TCP segs ~200B).
Priya K: did HTTP/2 framing change? grpc->http2 writev behavior lately?
Alex W: we rolled grpc write coalesce change in canary (PR #4523) to reduce buffering; might've over-optimized for memory leading to more small writes.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-15T10:02:14 completed to cluster-3
Maya S: hypothesis: aggressive draining leading to many writev syscalls; try batching socket writes at party boundary or re-introduce writev coalescing heuristics.
Jason R: alternative: use TCP_CORK on linux during serialization window, then release before epoll_wait. cheap if we can avoid head-of-line latency.
Priya K: KV cache lookups at 1.3ms — is that local memcache? could be lock contention on hot shard.
Alex W: yes local kvcache (sharded mutex). profile shows contention on shard 3 when requests hit identical prefixes.
Maya S: quick experiments:
- bump kvcache shard count 8->32
- switch shard locks to seqlock-read path
- re-enable writev coalesce with threshold 1KB
Jason R: also check kernel selection for small-batch decoding. we sometimes pick vec-optim kernels that increase host preproc due to alignment.
Alex W: noted. I'll run three branches and post microbench:
1) kvcache-shards-32
2) writev-coalesce-threshold-1kb
3) kernel-fallthrough-disable-smallbatches
Alex W: plan: canary each change separately on cluster-3 w/ smoke harness. need volunteers for rollouts + metrics dashboards.
Priya K: I can own kvcache shard change.
Jason R: I'll take writev coalesce. can you add an eval set for short completions? use short-chat-1000 prompt set.
Maya S: i'll do kernel change + perf traces.
Alex W: timeline: run perf harness today, canary tomorrow, rollback policy = immediate fallback to previous write path. tag me in prs. 
Priya K: noted. created a test branch: kvcache/shards-32
Jason R: have a small patch ready: net/writev-coalesce-1kb
Maya S: started profiling run: https://perf.internal/reports/8887654321
Alex W: thanks all — let's sync in eng-runtime sync if we have significant regressions. :thumbsup:
